summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five orders reported stuck; four now COMPLETED. One remains stuck (AE260812-57849665) at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after partial cancellation failure. Parallel fan-out investigation launched for DB state and Kibana logs. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  Five stuck AE orders investigated. Three resolved (stock update, PC-52918 remediation, address fix). Two remain at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — one awaiting warehouse shipment, one blocked on SMC UPDATE_ERROR pending PC-53305 approval. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns in the UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report. Script created under PC-53535 adding columns U-AL. PC-53535 reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Deployment via HAC scripting console pending. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Trade-in clawback triggered automatically for two orders but Checkout.com declined both card payments. Orders COMPLETED but clawback stuck at payment step. Awaiting confirmation on updated customer card details before re-triggering.

PC-5 — 

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable PC ticket for SMC re-registration remediation covering order AE260819-63130115 with SMC UPDATE_ERROR. Investigation confirmed SMC API failure during device update call. Script ready, awaiting approval.

PC-53535 — 
  Adds 18 SubscriptionData columns (U-AL) to UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report script. Updates gcc-PROD-Daily-SC-ReportScript via HAC. Reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Rollback reverts to version 44. Parent: AEME-6535. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Adds Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report. SaSalesReport.groovy updated with 2 new @ColumnMethod handlers using existing Order getters. No build needed — Groovy loaded dynamically. Script ready. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  Return blocked for SA screen repair order — GCIC service order past cancellable window (beyond ST030). Hybris correctly blocks return per GCIC status check. Options: contact GCIC for status rollback or enable config bypass. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  Healthcheck for 17 stuck TR-region orders. 5 already resolved. 12 remain across 5 root causes: FI connection errors, GetMobil NPE, refund failures, WMS dispatch blocks, and shipping date issues. New PC ticket needed for scripted remediation. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Master data creation for TR store C750_007_31536 (Antalya). ImpEx generated and cross-checked against Excel source. PC-53498 created, reviewed, approved, and executed. Reporter confirmed data correct. Completed. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
